Home / Museum Ship Reports / Qingdao Navy Museum

Location: 8 Laiyang Road, Shinan District, Qingdao, Shandong, China

Visited: 4 October 2014, 30 December 2019

The first time I went to the Chinese Navy Museum in Qingdao (Tsingtao) a number of their ships were absent due to construction works, and when I went back in 2019 the entire museum was closed, and I had to resort to walking around the perimeter taking photos. But across the two visits, I managed to spot the following ships:

  • The ex-Soviet WW2 Gnevny class destroyer Anshan (ex-Rekordny)
  • The Frigate Jinan
  • A Luda II class Destroyer
  • An Osa class missile boat (or possibly a Chinese clone)
  • A Hovercraft
  • Four Motor Torpedo Boats
  • Two Patrol boats, and
  • A Landing Craft.

The nuclear submarine Long March is also there - but is technically a separate museum.

I believe they have at least one more frigate and possibly some diesel submarines which were absent for both of my visits.

There is also a large number of guns, missiles, planes, tanks and various other exhibits which were all just piled together - almost on top of each other. I haven’t been back since the museum reconstruction has been completed, but I am sure they will be better laid out now.
